about_the_game:
・Overview

"Rise of Rebellion" is a single-player 3D action RPG that pursues strategicity through operations during battle.

In this title, the players battle the invaders they encounter on the island in order to retake their invaded homeland.

The combat system is based on melee combat with swords,
The key to the strategy is how to break down the enemy's guard and inflict damage with a wide variety of attacks.

In addition, “Arts” that can be used by “Mei,” energy derived from the earth, can be used to
It is also possible to generate “earth punishment” by hitting an enemy that is running out of stamina.

This is the same for the protagonist, who, by being hit by an enemy's art while running out of stamina
The main character is also subjected to “land punishment” by being hit by an enemy's art while running out of stamina.

The strategic nature of the game increases as the player must find a way to cut down the enemy's stamina without decreasing his own stamina,
You can enjoy the “link feeling” of facing off against a strong enemy and sweating your hands.

・Story

"If God exists, he must be a jealous God."

The dragons that once aimed at the sky were extinct due to the earth punishment.

People worshiped God and the land where God dwelled.

The earth was full of "May", and the warriors who mastered it were called "Manus".

You fight to regain your hometown as a Manus.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600/AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1650/Radeon RX 6500 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-6700/AMD Ryzen 5 1500X
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 3060/Radeon RX 6600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 12 MB available space

short_description: "Rise of Rebellion" is a 3D action RPG that pursues the tension of confronting strong enemies and sweating in your hands. People worshiped God and the land where God dwelled. Survive the battlefield by mastering the deep tactics of melee weapons and the energy "May" derived from the earth.
